chosen.label: MurderTrial
chosen.definition: A trial for a murder case.
chosen.justification: No existing schema.org type specifically matches a murder trial.

candidates.label: PerformingArtsEvent
candidates.comment: A PerformingArtsEvent is an event featuring live performances of arts like music, theatre, dance, or acrobatics. Also called live performance, show, stage event. Examples: a Broadway play, a ballet performance, a circus show, a stand-up comedy act. Distinct from MusicEvent, which is specifically for music.

candidates.label: SportsEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving athletic competition or display. Also called athletic contest, game, match, sporting competition. Examples: a football game, an Olympic event, a marathon race, a tennis tournament.

candidates.label: TheaterEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing a live performance in a theater. Also called stage play, theatrical show, drama performance. Examples: a Broadway musical, a local community play, a Shakespearean tragedy.

candidates.label: MusicEvent
candidates.comment: A MusicEvent is an event primarily featuring musical performances. Also called concert, musical performance, gig. Examples: a rock concert, a classical symphony performance, a music festival. Distinct from PerformingArtsEvent, which includes broader performance types like theatre or dance.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

chosen.label: Shooting
chosen.definition: An event where someone is shot.
chosen.justification: No existing schema.org type specifically matches a shooting event.

candidates.label: ScreeningEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving the public showing of a movie or other video content. Also called film screening, movie showing, video presentation, cinema event. Examples: a film festival screening, a premiere showing of a new movie, a public documentary viewing, a drive-in movie night.

candidates.label: UserInteraction
candidates.comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.

candidates.label: CourseInstance
candidates.comment: A CourseInstance is a specific offering of an educational course, distinguished by its particular time, location, medium, or target student group. Also called course section, class session, course offering, specific class. Examples: "Fall 2023 Introduction to Python (Online)," "Spring 2024 Art History 101 (Campus A, Section B)," "Summer Intensive Yoga Teacher Training." Distinct from Course, which is the general description of the educational content.
